title: ledger: inter-process lock; non-destructive recovery; recovery-preserve regression test

Fix: flock(LOCK_EX) around load+append+recover or O_EXCL lockfile; recovery refuses rather than truncates when lock unavailable. Include the missing regression test for the preserve branch of recover (complete event minus trailing newline; only the truncated branch is tested today, tests/ledger.rs:228-272).

title: ledger: validate supersedes targets and shapes at append; surface cycles and dangling corrections

title: Design thread: DocIR, doctests, documentation commit gate
description: Recovered from the origin conversation (chatgpt 6afa5381, later turns): structured DocIR as central artifact; doctests as first-class objects with runners and expected output; documentation impact analysis as a commit gate (change -> impact set -> required dispositions -> validation -> gate); Org as authoring frontend with KAYA_* properties. Not in any current spec. Keep parked until the taxonomy change lands; scope decision required before design.
acceptance_criteria: Deliverable is an openspec proposal (or an explicit recorded rejection) for DocIR, doctests, and the documentation commit gate, stating the central-artifact decision and its consequences for kaya.projection and kaya.documents. No production code. Meter: the proposal exists and openspec validate --changes --strict passes.
notes:
Design delivered: openspec/changes/add-document-ir-commit-gate (proposal + deltas for kaya-projection/kaya-documents + new kaya-impact spec and layer + tasks). Decision: adopt a scoped DocIR as central documentation artifact — derived, never authoritative (ledger stays epistemic SSOT; authored bytes stay in markdown). Doctests = first-class IR records under test-runner (kind doctest). Commit gate = kaya.impact: change -> impact set over IR dependency edges -> closed dispositions (updated/validated/reviewed/waived; reviewed+waived are human verification-family events) -> deterministic report, exit nonzero exactly on fail. Org frontend rejected for now (revisit conditions in proposal Out of Scope). Validate: openspec validate --changes --strict PASS; spk lint overlay 0 issues; ah check clean. Awaiting ratification of the central-artifact decision before closing.
Rule-of-5-universal review applied (9 findings, 0 critical): IR-scenario rescoped to build caches/copies outside document sources (docs/research files are sources AND outputs — mod.rs:280, main.rs:807); mechanical dispositions (validated/updated) defined as derived states with their own requirement, layer constraint mechanical_dispositions_derived, property row + mirror scenario; waiver binds to dependency digest and lapses on change; reviewed/waived event shape pinned (subject Document, data carries record id/actor/rationale) and refusal scoped to only-human (mirrors main.rs:144); containment record-to-record edges added licensing transitive impact; proposal contrast claims corrected (recomputed-vs-unchanged tracking exists; source map is render-coupled tracing, not a parallel pass; cites stays a model attribution relationship, IR graph is new); doctest normalization policy pinned in task 2.2. Post-fix: openspec validate --strict PASS; spk lint 0 issues. Awaiting ratification to close.
